description: This file is a configuration and build script (Makefile) for building glibc version 2.37 as part of the OpenWrt project. It includes variables, build instructions, and configuration commands for cross-compiling glibc, along with license information and inclusion of other Makefiles.

methods.name: Host/SetToolchainInfo
methods.description: Sets toolchain related information in info.mk.

methods.name: Host/Configure
methods.description: Creates build directory and runs the glibc configure script with appropriate options.

methods.name: Host/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the build environment, including creating symbolic links for source directories.

methods.name: Host/Clean
methods.description: Removes build directories and intermediate files to clean the build environment.
